index_name.description: Name of the Azure AI Search index built by the Azure Files indexer.

index_layout.description: document_per_file for the indexer's default one-document-per-file index, chunked for integrated vectorization with index projections, or custom to map every field.

content_field.description: Searchable text field. Defaults to content (document per file) or chunk (chunked).

title_field.description: Optional title field shown with results.

path_field.description: Field holding the file's Azure Files URL. Defaults to metadata_storage_path.

name_field.description: Field holding the file name. Defaults to metadata_storage_name.

vector_field.description: Vector field used by hybrid search through the index's vectorizer.

select_content.description: Return the content field for snippets. Chunked indexes do; whole-file indexes use captions or highlights instead.

query_mode.description: keyword, semantic (needs a semantic configuration), or hybrid (needs a vector field with a vectorizer).

semantic_configuration.description: Semantic configuration name. Leave blank to use the index default.

default_top_n.description: Results returned when the agent does not ask for a number.

max_candidates.description: Search hits examined per query before permission checks.

max_snippet_chars.description: Maximum characters of text returned per result.

time_budget_seconds.description: Time allowed for permission checks; files not checked in time are withheld.

permission_mode.description: live_acl checks each file's permissions for the signed-in user; none returns every matching file.

share_access_check.description: rbac checks share-level permissions (default share permission and Azure role assignments); skip relies on file permissions only.

treat_builtin_users_as_member.description: Treat entries for BUILTIN\Users as applying to every signed-in user.

storage_account_resource_id.description: Azure resource ID of the storage account.

storage_shares.description: File shares this index was built from. Results from other shares are withheld.
